sentences.text:
In Re : An application for anticipatory bail under secti  2023 in connection with Banshihari P.S Case no. 121 of 2  28.4.2024 under sections 498A/302/34 IPC  Allowed and  In Re : Rita Roy & Anr. ....
 Mr. Kaushik Choiudhury  ...... for the pet  Ms. Subhasree Patel  Ms. Debalina Das  ...... for the Sta  1.
Petitioners submit they are the villagers and they did not play any role in the matrimonial life of the couple.
2. Learned lawyer for the State submits petitioner no.1's husband had an affair with the deceased.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
Allegations against the petitioners are general and omnibus.
Co-accused similarly circumstanced with the petitioners have been granted pre-arrest bail.
4. Under such circumstances we are inclined to extend the same relief to the petitioners also.

5. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs. 10,000/- each with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under section 482(2) of BNSS 2023.
6. Petitioners shall appear before the jurisdictional court and pray for regular bail within four weeks from date.
7. The application being CRM (A) 99 of 2025 is disposed of.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.) Signed By :
TAMAL KRISHNA MANDAL High Court of Calcutta 13 th of January 2025 05:19:27 PM CRM (A)/99/2025 on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29870268/
